description.text: The major of energy and power engineering originated from the power plant major set up by Shanghai Shipbuilding Industry School in 1953, is one of the earliest majors in our school, has a first-level discipline master's program, is a national first-class undergraduate professional construction point, Jiangsu Province first-class undergraduate professional construction point, is a pilot major for the training of outstanding engineers in Jiangsu Province, was approved by the Ministry of Education in 2019 Sino-foreign cooperative education project, in 2020 approved by the China Scholarship Fund as a pilot training project. It has built scientific research and teaching practice platforms such as Jiangsu Provincial Key Laboratory of International Cooperation on Green Power and Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction, Zhenjiang Key Laboratory of Ship Power Equipment Performance, and CSSC Power's Industry-Education Integration Training Base. There are nearly 25 full-time teachers, 2 professors and 9 associate professors in the major of energy and power engineering, and there are young and middle-aged science and technology leaders of Jiangsu "333" Project, leaders of Jiangsu "Blue Project" science and technology innovation team, 1 high-level talent of Jiangsu Province's "Six Talent Peaks", and 2 doctors of entrepreneurship and entrepreneurship in Jiangsu Province. In the past three years, he has been approved 5 scientific research projects at the provincial and ministerial level, published more than 50 SCI/EI papers, authorized 36 invention patents, published 2 monographs and 2 textbooks. The energy and power engineering major pays attention to the cultivation of students' professional skills and scientific spirit, and a group of outstanding alumni such as He Jianghua (National "May Day" model worker and LNG ship chief builder) have emerged. In the past five years, the discipline competition has won nearly 100 provincial and ministerial awards and above, the employment rate has been in the forefront of the university for many consecutive years, about 20% of the graduates serve the national defense cause, 50% enter the internationally renowned ship leading enterprises, and the employer has a good evaluation. The major of energy and power engineering will face the development needs of new ship power technologies in the ship and marine energy equipment manufacturing industry and naval defense, actively adapt to the challenges and requirements of industry development for talent training, adhere to the concept of interdisciplinary development, strengthen students' innovation and entrepreneurship capabilities, optimize the top-level design of application-oriented talent training, strengthen professional certification, innovation and entrepreneurship and the internationalization of education, and strive to build a training base for designing and manufacturing talents in the field of ship energy power in China.

duration.text: The Energy and Power Engineering at Jiangsu University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1562 USD/per year ￥ 11250 CNY/per year

materials.text: 5.1 Foreign Medical Examination Forms. 5.2 Certificate of English or Chinese Proficiency. 5.3 Copy of passport (a valid ordinary passport) and one passport-sized photo. 5.4 Undergraduate applicants, educational qualification certificates, original or notarized copies (in English or Chinese); for those who are still in their final year of study, they should provide proof of expected graduation. 5.5 For graduate applicants, the following academic materials are required: original or notarized copies of the undergraduate transcript and bachelor's degree certificate (in either English or Chinese), two recommendation letters from different referees (in Chinese or English), and at least an associate professor (or equivalent title) position. 5.6 The academic materials required for doctoral program applicants are: the original or notarized copy of the student's academic transcript and the master's degree certificate (in either English or Chinese), two recommendation letters from different professors, published papers, and the research plan for pursuing a doctoral degree in China. 5.6 Self-funded international students should designate a trustee in China and provide financial guarantee (international students who do not receive support from the Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship are classified as self-funded full-time graduate students).

requirements.text: 4.1 Hold a foreign passport, be in good health, and abide by Chinese laws and the regulations of JUST. 4.2 Undergraduate students should hold a high school diploma and be generally under 30 years old; master's degree holders should have a bachelor's degree and be generally under 40 years old; doctoral degree holders should have a master's degree and be generally under 45 years old. 4.3 The language proficiency requirements for applicants of English-taught programs are as follows. For bachelor's degree programs - 75 points on the IBT or 5.5 points on the IELTS; for master's or higher degree programs - 80 points on the IBT or 6 points on the IELTS. However, no such requirements apply to native English speakers. For Chinese-taught programs, applicants must have a recent HSK 4 certificate (within two years).
